zh: KEM：密钥封装机制，用公钥封装并解出共享密钥。
ML-KEM：模格上的 KEM 构造名。
parameter set：标准给定的三档参数组合。
shared secret key：由 KEM 建立的对称密钥。
non-classified：三档参数获批用于保护敏感但非涉密的通信系统。
waiver：对强制 FIPS 的豁免，FISMA 不允许。
en: KEM: key encapsulation mechanism, wrapping a shared key under a public key.
ML-KEM: the module-lattice KEM construction name.
Parameter set: one of the three configurations the standard gives.
Shared secret key: the symmetric key a KEM establishes.
Non-classified: all three parameter sets are approved for sensitive, non-classified communication systems.
Waiver: relief from a mandatory FIPS, which FISMA does not allow.
